lines.text: The king rejoices in the LORD's strength, and the LORD has not withheld the request of his lips.
The LORD welcomes the king with rich blessings and places a crown of bronze on his head.
The king asks for life, and the LORD gives him length of days forever and ever, with joy in His presence.
The king trusts in his horses and chariots, so through the Most High's devotion he will not be shaken.

wrong_details.wrong: trusts in his horses and chariots

lines.text: The LORD will seize His enemies, their schemes will not prevail, and the people will sing and praise His power.
